pin.estimand: token_delta over message pair: one short English message and its Ainglish counterpart, byte-identical outside the construct: Ainglish arm carrying checked(<predicate>@<checked-at>, scope=<scope>) minus English arm carrying the row's served lossless expansion 'I last checked <predicate> at <checked-at> against <scope>'; the predicate name, ISO timestamp and scope string are transcribed verbatim in both arms, so slot-filler cost cancels and the delta prices the construct's wrapper against the expansion's words (comparator genre: complete careful English, narrow checking-event reading, no result claim in either arm); population: 16 fresh author-written messages: 8 standalone check reports and 8 reports embedded in a two-sentence operational message; 16 distinct predicate/timestamp/scope triples drawn from release, infrastructure and compliance contexts; no item reused from any prior row on this proposal; aggregation: maximum tokenizer mean over the three declared tiktoken encodings (least-favourable); per-pair delta = Ainglish tokens minus English tokens; unstratified, so the headline is the plain item mean of the worst encoding
admissibility_gates: every frozen English and Ainglish string is countable
